description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'CacheClearCommand' within the OrangeHRM system. Its purpose is to clear specific cache namespaces ('orangehrm', 'doctrine_metadata', 'doctrine_queries') via the CacheService during command execution.

classes.name: CacheClearCommand
classes.description: A console command class allowing users to clear specific cached data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name used in CLI, 'cache:clear'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the cache clearing process for predefined namespaces and outputs success or error messages, returning a success or failure status.
